title: Exact Sparse Assignment with Costly Target Embeddings: Fixed-Realization Certificates and an Empirical Audit
abstract: arXiv:2611.19770v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embedding-based one-to-one association is common in vision and data integration: detections are associated with tracks and records are linked across databases. Such pipelines often solve a sparse optional assignment whose edge scores add a cheap term to an inner product of neural embeddings. When target embeddings are costly, one can acquire them selectively and stop once a certificate proves that the current assignment is optimal. We give such a certificate for unit-norm embeddings. It bounds the unknown part of every reassignment by a support function and maximizes the resulting robust gains with a second sparse assignment; a shared owner-centred bound dominates any fixed-centre triangle bound. We make precise what is certified when network features are not batch-invariant: the realized values of the acquired rows and every unit-ball completion of the rest, not a second forward pass in a different batch. translated_title: 具有高成本目标嵌入的精确稀疏分配：固定实现证书与实证审计
translated_abstract: 基于嵌入的一对一关联在视觉和数据整合中十分常见：检测结果与跟踪轨迹相关联，记录在数据库之间进行链接。这类流程通常需要求解一个稀疏的可选分配问题，其边得分是在神经网络嵌入内积的基础上增加一个廉价的项。当目标嵌入的获取成本高昂时，可以选择性地获取它们，并在证书证明当前分配已是最优时停止获取。我们为单位范数嵌入给出了这样一个证书：它通过支撑函数界定每次重新分配中未知的部分，并通过第二次稀疏分配来最大化由此产生的鲁棒增益；共享的所有者中心界支配任何固定中心的三角界。我们精确阐明了当网络特征不满足批次不变性时证书所保证的内容：即所获取各行的实现值以及其余行的每个单位球补全，而不是在不同批次中的第二次前向传播。通过对照单独……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种针对单位范数嵌入的最优性证书方法，能够在选择性获取高成本目标嵌入的过程中证明当前稀疏分配已精确最优，并明确界定了在网络特征不满足批次不变性时证书所保证的最优性范围。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces optimality certificates for unit-norm embeddings that enable selective acquisition of costly target embeddings with a guaranteed proof that the current sparse assignment is exactly optimal, while precisely characterizing what is certified when network features are not batch-invariant.
